news.detail: Retry list first: all 141 leads retried again (OpenAlex locations, DOI registries, direct re-read with PDF text extraction, Wayback captures, DOAJ, DSpace/NVA/DiVA/theses.fr APIs, CiNii, NDL/DNB/BnF catalogues, Open Library, Internet Archive, Google Books, DataCite, Semantic Scholar as aggregator only); 12 promoted (R5250–R5261): twelve leads opened by routes not used before or by different captures: Wayback copies of repository records and PDFs (Ecuadorean university theses on pervious concrete and recycled glass, a KAIST pumping thesis, a University of Michigan DeepBlue record, a Springer 2007 self-healing conference paper, Boynton's lime/limestone book page), archived TRID records (Westergaard 1927 pavement temperature stresses, Packard 1984 thickness design, a 2018 Kansas QC/QA report), a DergiPark article page, an EPN repository record and the ACI abstracts-portal page of a 1983 slag/fly-ash admixture paper. 146 leads stay on the review list (129 carried over, 17 new from discovery). The open queue was empty. Discovery (OpenAlex backfill of the least-covered topics: oil-well/geothermal cements, special binders (CSA, CAC, rapid-set, expansive, magnesium phosphate), magnesium and carbonatable binders, calcined clays and LC3, mass concrete/RCC, cellular concrete, heavyweight/shielding concrete, shotcrete, blended cements, white cement and masonry mortars, lightweight concrete, natural pozzolans and international cement industries; historical searches back to the 1960s, 21 language-filtered sweeps and a current-awareness sweep through Nov 27) checked 424 leads and added 403 verified sources, 61 non-English records (English title glosses) and 60 dated 2026 or later. Mostly DOI/abstract or record-page level, not full-text reviews. The unpublished Nov 26 pass (R4909–R5249) is published in the same bundle.
